title: Fluent product rebrand
objective: Rename the visible desktop product and its executable from Fluent to Fluent while preserving all existing local behavior, compatibility paths, internal namespaces, security controls, and undeployed Cloud posture.

included: Visible Fluent branding in the main WPF window and recording capsule
The single public already-processing status message in MainWindow.xaml.cs
Fluent executable and product metadata in Fluent.App.csproj
Current product documentation and README branding updates
Release build, complete test suite, focused documentation and compatibility review
excluded: Any namespace, folder, project-file, solution-file, repository, GitHub remote, or package rename
Any change to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Fluent or migration of existing user data
Any change to dictation, transcription, rewriting, insertion, authentication, Cloud providers, security controls, or user consent
DeepSeek activation, provider keys, deployment, live Cloud calls, new dependencies, publication, or Git push

acceptanceCriteria: The visible main window title, dashboard header, floating capsule, and already-processing status message display Fluent and no longer display Fluent.
The Release app output is Fluent.exe with Product metadata Fluent.
All Fluent.* namespaces, project paths, the solution, and %LOCALAPPDATA%\Fluent remain unchanged, so no existing local dictionary migration occurs.
The Release solution build has zero warnings and zero errors, and the complete existing test suite passes.
No source in the transcript, rewrite, insertion, authentication, provider, or security paths changes.
risks: A broad text replacement could unintentionally rename technical namespaces or compatibility data paths.
An executable-name change could leave the prior binary on disk and create launch ambiguity until the next clean build.
Current and historical documentation could be mixed, making the project status misleading.
rollbackPlan: Restore the four public branding files and app project metadata to Fluent.
Rebuild Release and rerun the complete test suite.
Do not alter local user data, source namespaces, project paths, or Git history.
dependencies: Explicit user direction on 2026-07-21 to rename the application or project Fluent.
Phase 06B remains implemented awaiting a separate user review; no Cloud or DeepSeek change is included.
humanApprovals: On 2026-07-21, the user explicitly requested that the application or project be renamed Fluent and asked to continue the project.

verification.planJudge: ALLOW on 2026-07-21 for public Fluent branding only; internal namespaces, repository, solution, data path, providers, and DeepSeek remain excluded.
